schema.name: local_executor_identity
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE local_executor_identity (
		singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1),
		node_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(node_id AS BLOB)) = 36),
		installation_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(installation_id AS BLOB)) = 36),
		commitment_key BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(commitment_key) = 'blob' AND length(commitment_key) = 32)
	)

schema.name: job_submissions
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE job_submissions (
		job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		configuration_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		installation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('prepared', 'pending', 'accepted')),
		spec_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json))
	)

schema.name: idx_job_submissions_pending
schema.ddl:
CREATE INDEX idx_job_submissions_pending ON job_submissions(job_id)
		WHERE state IN ('prepared', 'pending')

schema.name: job_control_targets
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE job_control_targets (
		command_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		submission_job_id TEXT,
		mirror_job_id TEXT,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		CHECK((submission_job_id IS NOT NULL AND mirror_job_id IS NULL AND submission_job_id = job_id)
			OR (submission_job_id IS NULL AND mirror_job_id IS NOT NULL AND mirror_job_id = job_id)),
		UNIQUE(command_id, job_id),
		FOREIGN KEY(submission_job_id) REFERENCES job_submissions(job_id),
		FOREIGN KEY(mirror_job_id) REFERENCES remote_job_mirrors(job_id)
	)

schema.name: job_control_outbox
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE job_control_outbox (
		command_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'rejected')),
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		FOREIGN KEY(command_id, job_id) REFERENCES job_control_targets(command_id, job_id)
	)

schema.name: idx_job_control_outbox_pending
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_job_control_outbox_pending ON job_control_outbox(command_id) WHERE state = 'pending'

schema.name: idx_job_control_outbox_job
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_job_control_outbox_job ON job_control_outbox(job_id, command_id)

schema.name: remote_performance_results
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE remote_performance_results (
		job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		report_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES remote_job_mirrors(job_id)
	)

schema.name: remote_job_mirrors
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE remote_job_mirrors (
		job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		configuration_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		installation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		spec_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		spec_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(spec_json)),
		snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(snapshot_json)),
		applied_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(applied_sequence > 0),
		comparison_id TEXT UNIQUE,
		performance_report_id TEXT UNIQUE
	)

schema.name: idx_remote_job_mirrors_node
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_remote_job_mirrors_node ON remote_job_mirrors(configuration_id, installation_id, job_id)

schema.name: remote_job_runs
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE remote_job_runs (
		run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position >= 0),
		UNIQUE(job_id, position),
		FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES execution_runs(id),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES remote_job_mirrors(job_id)
	)

schema.name: remote_job_events
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE remote_job_events (
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence > 0),
		kind TEXT NOT NULL,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		PRIMARY KEY(job_id, sequence),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES remote_job_mirrors(job_id)
	)

schema.name: remote_job_report_refs
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE remote_job_report_refs (
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		reference_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reference_type IN ('report', 'performance_result')),
		report_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		imported INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(imported IN (0, 1)),
		PRIMARY KEY(job_id, reference_type, report_id),
		UNIQUE(reference_type, report_id),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES remote_job_mirrors(job_id)
	)

schema.name: execution_performance_observations
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE execution_performance_observations (
		job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES execution_jobs(id)
	)

schema.name: execution_performance_results
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE execution_performance_results (
		job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		report_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
		job_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(job_revision > 0),
		status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
		sealed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_size > 0),
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES execution_jobs(id)
	)

schema.name: execution_job_commands
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE execution_job_commands (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('stop_sending', 'cancel')),
		expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expected_revision > 0),
		accepted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES execution_jobs(id)
	)

schema.name: execution_jobs
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE execution_jobs (
		accepted_sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
		id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
		installation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		engine_build_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('run', 'performance', 'comparison')),
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('queued', 'starting', 'running', 'draining', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
		accepted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		spec_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		secret_commitment TEXT NOT NULL,
		spec_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(spec_json)),
		snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(snapshot_json)),
		last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(last_sequence >= revision),
		settled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(settled IN (0, 1))
	)

schema.name: idx_execution_jobs_active
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_execution_jobs_active ON execution_jobs(status, accepted_sequence)

schema.name: idx_execution_jobs_performance_report
schema.ddl:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_execution_jobs_performance_report
		ON execution_jobs(json_extract(spec_json, '$.spec.performance.report_id')) WHERE kind = 'performance'

schema.name: idx_execution_jobs_comparison
schema.ddl:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_execution_jobs_comparison
		ON execution_jobs(json_extract(spec_json, '$.spec.comparison.meta.id')) WHERE kind = 'comparison'

schema.name: execution_job_runs
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE execution_job_runs (
		run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position >= 0),
		UNIQUE(job_id, position),
		UNIQUE(job_id, run_id),
		FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES execution_runs(id),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES execution_jobs(id)
	)

schema.name: execution_job_events
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE execution_job_events (
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence > 0),
		kind TEXT NOT NULL,
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		PRIMARY KEY(job_id, sequence),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES execution_jobs(id)
	)

schema.name: schema_migrations
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
		version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
		name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
		checksum TEXT NOT NULL,
		applied_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		app_version TEXT NOT NULL
	)

schema.name: runs
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE runs (
		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
		ts TEXT, url TEXT, model TEXT, requests INTEGER,
		duration INTEGER, max_tokens INTEGER, input_tokens INTEGER,
		stream INTEGER, random INTEGER,
		success INTEGER, total INTEGER, ttft_p50 REAL, ttft_p90 REAL,
		tpot_p50 REAL, tpot_p90 REAL, e2e_p50 REAL, e2e_p90 REAL,
		cached INTEGER, prompt_total INTEGER, config TEXT,
		concurrency INTEGER, timeout INTEGER, failures INTEGER,
		elapsed REAL, qps REAL, total_tpm REAL, peak_in_flight INTEGER,
		request_template TEXT, capture_policy TEXT,
		capture_sample_limit INTEGER
	)

schema.name: run_results
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE run_results (
		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
		run_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
		request_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
		status INTEGER, e2e_ms REAL, ttft_ms REAL, tpot_ms REAL,
		queue_ms REAL, started_at_s REAL, completed_at_s REAL,
		prompt_tokens INTEGER, completion_tokens INTEGER, cached_tokens INTEGER,
		chunks INTEGER, error TEXT, request_body TEXT, response_body TEXT,
		response_text TEXT,
		FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES runs(id)
	)

schema.name: idx_run_results_run_id
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_run_results_run_id ON run_results(run_id)

schema.name: audit_runs
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE audit_runs (
		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
		ts TEXT NOT NULL, suite TEXT NOT NULL, base_url TEXT NOT NULL,
		model TEXT NOT NULL, total INTEGER NOT NULL, overall TEXT NOT NULL,
		verdict TEXT NOT NULL, summary_json TEXT NOT NULL, config_json TEXT NOT NULL,
		report_dir TEXT NOT NULL, report_json TEXT NOT NULL, report_html TEXT NOT NULL
	)

schema.name: audit_case_results
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE audit_case_results (
		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
		audit_run_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
		sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
		case_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, dimension TEXT NOT NULL,
		protocol TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
		severity TEXT NOT NULL, elapsed_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
		evidence TEXT NOT NULL, http_status INTEGER NOT NULL,
		metrics_json TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
		artifact_dir TEXT NOT NULL,
		FOREIGN KEY(audit_run_id) REFERENCES audit_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
		UNIQUE(audit_run_id, sequence)
	)

schema.name: idx_audit_runs_ts
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_runs_ts ON audit_runs(ts DESC)

schema.name: idx_audit_case_results_run_id
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_case_results_run_id ON audit_case_results(audit_run_id)

schema.name: execution_runs
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE execution_runs (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		current_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(current_revision > 0),
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sealed IN (0, 1)),
		FOREIGN KEY(id, current_revision)
			REFERENCES execution_run_revisions(run_id, revision)
			DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
	)

schema.name: evidence
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE evidence (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES execution_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
	)

schema.name: case_results
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE case_results (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		case_id TEXT,
		request_id TEXT,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES execution_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
		UNIQUE(run_id, request_id)
	)

schema.name: reports
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE reports (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
		run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
		generated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES execution_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
	)

schema.name: artifacts
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE artifacts (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		name TEXT NOT NULL,
		relative_path TEXT NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		media_type TEXT NOT NULL,
		redacted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(redacted IN (0, 1)),
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES execution_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
		UNIQUE(run_id, relative_path)
	)

schema.name: report_attachments
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE report_attachments (
		report_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position >= 0),
		PRIMARY KEY(report_id, artifact_id),
		UNIQUE(report_id, position),
		FOREIGN KEY(report_id) REFERENCES reports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
		FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts(id)
	)

schema.name: idx_case_results_run
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_case_results_run ON case_results(run_id, created_at, id)

schema.name: idx_case_results_case_summary
schema.ddl: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_case_results_case_summary ON case_results(run_id, entry_id, case_id) WHERE request_id IS NULL AND case_id IS NOT NULL AND entry_id IS NOT NULL

schema.name: idx_case_results_entry_marker
schema.ddl: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_case_results_entry_marker ON case_results(run_id, entry_id) WHERE entry_id IS NOT NULL AND case_id IS NULL AND request_id IS NULL

schema.name: idx_evidence_run
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_evidence_run ON evidence(run_id, created_at, id)

schema.name: idx_reports_run
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_reports_run ON reports(run_id)

schema.name: comparisons
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE comparisons (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		current_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(current_revision > 0),
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sealed IN (0, 1)),
		FOREIGN KEY(id, current_revision)
			REFERENCES comparison_revisions(comparison_id, revision)
			DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
	)

schema.name: quick_performance_reports
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE quick_performance_reports (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		generated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		generated_at_unix_nano INTEGER NOT NULL,
		success INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(success IN (0, 1)),
		model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		base_url TEXT NOT NULL,
		phase TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(phase IN ('completed', 'cancelled')),
		completed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(completed > 0 AND completed <= 10000),
		failed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(failed >= 0 AND failed <= completed),
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json))
	)

schema.name: idx_quick_performance_reports_generated
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_quick_performance_reports_generated ON quick_performance_reports(generated_at_unix_nano DESC, id DESC)

schema.name: quick_performance_reports_no_update
schema.ddl:
CREATE TRIGGER quick_performance_reports_no_update
		BEFORE UPDATE ON quick_performance_reports
		BEGIN
			SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quick performance reports are immutable');
		END

schema.name: quick_performance_reports_no_delete
schema.ddl:
CREATE TRIGGER quick_performance_reports_no_delete
		BEFORE DELETE ON quick_performance_reports
		BEGIN
			SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'quick performance reports are immutable');
		END

schema.name: execution_run_revisions
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE execution_run_revisions (
		run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
		status TEXT NOT NULL,
		snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(snapshot_json)),
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		PRIMARY KEY(run_id, revision),
		FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES execution_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
	)

schema.name: idx_execution_run_revisions_updated
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_execution_run_revisions_updated ON execution_run_revisions(updated_at DESC, run_id)

schema.name: trg_execution_run_revisions_no_update
schema.ddl:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_execution_run_revisions_no_update
		BEFORE UPDATE ON execution_run_revisions
		BEGIN
			SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'execution run revisions are immutable');
		END

schema.name: trg_execution_run_revisions_no_delete
schema.ddl:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_execution_run_revisions_no_delete
		BEFORE DELETE ON execution_run_revisions
		BEGIN
			SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'execution run revisions are immutable');
		END

schema.name: trg_execution_run_revisions_contiguous_insert
schema.ddl:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_execution_run_revisions_contiguous_insert
		BEFORE INSERT ON execution_run_revisions
		WHEN NEW.revision != COALESCE(
			(SELECT MAX(revision) + 1 FROM execution_run_revisions WHERE run_id = NEW.run_id),
			1
		)
		BEGIN
			SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'execution run revisions must be contiguous');
		END

schema.name: comparison_revisions
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE comparison_revisions (
		comparison_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
		model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		model_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
		status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('running', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json)),
		PRIMARY KEY(comparison_id, revision),
		FOREIGN KEY(comparison_id) REFERENCES comparisons(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
	)

schema.name: comparison_runs
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE comparison_runs (
		comparison_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		comparison_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
		position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position >= 0),
		channel_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		channel_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
		run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		PRIMARY KEY(comparison_id, comparison_revision, position),
		UNIQUE(comparison_id, comparison_revision, channel_id),
		UNIQUE(comparison_id, comparison_revision, run_id),
		FOREIGN KEY(comparison_id, comparison_revision)
			REFERENCES comparison_revisions(comparison_id, revision) ON DELETE CASCADE,
		FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES execution_runs(id)
	)

schema.name: idx_comparison_revisions_updated
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_comparison_revisions_updated ON comparison_revisions(updated_at DESC, comparison_id)

schema.name: comparison_revisions_no_update
schema.ddl:
CREATE TRIGGER comparison_revisions_no_update
		BEFORE UPDATE ON comparison_revisions
		BEGIN
			SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'comparison revisions are immutable');
		END

schema.name: comparison_revisions_no_delete
schema.ddl:
CREATE TRIGGER comparison_revisions_no_delete
		BEFORE DELETE ON comparison_revisions
		BEGIN
			SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'comparison revisions are immutable');
		END

schema.name: content_stores
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE content_stores (
		store_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('executor', 'cache')),
		owner_installation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL
	)

schema.name: content_objects
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE content_objects (
		store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 1073741824),
		physical_incarnation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		witness_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(witness_sha256) = 64 AND witness_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		verified_change_token TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(verified_change_token) = 64 AND verified_change_token NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		physical_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(physical_state IN ('present', 'deleting', 'absent', 'quarantined')),
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		PRIMARY KEY(store_id, sha256),
		UNIQUE(store_id, sha256, size),
		FOREIGN KEY(store_id) REFERENCES content_stores(store_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: content_generations
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE content_generations (
		store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation > 0),
		size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 1073741824),
		physical_incarnation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		witness_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(witness_sha256) = 64 AND witness_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		PRIMARY KEY(store_id, sha256, generation),
		UNIQUE(store_id, sha256, size, generation),
		UNIQUE(store_id, sha256, size, generation, witness_sha256),
		UNIQUE(store_id, sha256, size, generation, physical_incarnation_id, witness_sha256),
		FOREIGN KEY(store_id, sha256, size) REFERENCES content_objects(store_id, sha256, size) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: idx_content_generations_incarnation
schema.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_content_generations_incarnation ON content_generations(store_id, sha256, physical_incarnation_id)

schema.name: content_heads
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE content_heads (
		store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation > 0),
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		PRIMARY KEY(store_id, sha256),
		FOREIGN KEY(store_id, sha256, generation) REFERENCES content_generations(store_id, sha256, generation) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: execution_job_content
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE execution_job_content (
		job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		inventory_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(inventory_revision > 0),
		sealed_manifest_sha256 TEXT,
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES execution_jobs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id, sealed_manifest_sha256, inventory_revision)
			REFERENCES job_content_manifests(job_id, sha256, inventory_revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: job_content_entries
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE job_content_entries (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('input', 'artifact')),
		ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(ref AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
		run_id TEXT,
		store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 1073741824),
		media_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(media_type AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),
		generation INTEGER CHECK(generation > 0),
		state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('capturing', 'live', 'released', 'capture_failed')),
		failure_code TEXT CHECK(failure_code IN ('read_failed', 'integrity_mismatch', 'storage_unavailable', 'cancelled')),
		linked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		released_by_command TEXT,
		CHECK(role != 'input' OR (run_id IS NULL AND state IN ('live', 'released') AND generation IS NOT NULL)),
		CHECK((state IN ('live', 'released') AND generation IS NOT NULL AND failure_code IS NULL)
			OR (role = 'artifact' AND state = 'capturing' AND generation IS NULL AND failure_code IS NULL)
			OR (role = 'artifact' AND state = 'capture_failed' AND generation IS NULL AND failure_code IS NOT NULL)),
		CHECK((state = 'released' AND released_by_command IS NOT NULL) OR (state != 'released' AND released_by_command IS NULL)),
		UNIQUE(job_id, role, ref),
		UNIQUE(job_id, id, store_id, sha256, size, generation),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES execution_job_content(job_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id, run_id) REFERENCES execution_job_runs(job_id, run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(store_id) REFERENCES content_stores(store_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(store_id, sha256, size, generation)
			REFERENCES content_generations(store_id, sha256, size, generation) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id, id, released_by_command)
			REFERENCES job_content_release_items(job_id, item_id, command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: idx_job_content_entries_live

schema.name: job_content_manifests
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE job_content_manifests (
		job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304),
		inventory_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(inventory_revision > 0),
		terminal_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(terminal_revision > 0),
		sealed_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sealed_sequence > 0),
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json) AND length(CAST(document_json AS BLOB)) = size),
		UNIQUE(job_id, sha256),
		UNIQUE(job_id, sha256, inventory_revision),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES execution_job_content(job_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: job_content_manifest_items
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE job_content_manifest_items (
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position >= 0 AND position < 4224),
		store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 1073741824),
		generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation > 0),
		PRIMARY KEY(job_id, item_id),
		UNIQUE(job_id, position),
		UNIQUE(job_id, item_id, store_id, sha256, size, generation),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES job_content_manifests(job_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id, item_id, store_id, sha256, size, generation)
			REFERENCES job_content_entries(job_id, id, store_id, sha256, size, generation) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: job_content_hold_attestations
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE job_content_hold_attestations (
		receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		holder_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(request_sha256) = 64 AND request_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json) AND length(CAST(document_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192),
		auth_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(auth_scope = 'node'),
		UNIQUE(job_id, manifest_sha256, receipt_id),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id, manifest_sha256) REFERENCES job_content_manifests(job_id, sha256) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: job_content_releases
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE job_content_releases (
		command_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
		manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		hold_receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(request_sha256) = 64 AND request_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expected_revision > 0),
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('intent', 'completed', 'blocked')),
		started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		completed_at TEXT,
		tombstone_json TEXT CHECK(tombstone_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(tombstone_json) AND length(CAST(tombstone_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)),
		CHECK((state = 'completed' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND tombstone_json IS NOT NULL)
			OR (state != 'completed' AND completed_at IS NULL AND tombstone_json IS NULL)),
		UNIQUE(job_id, command_id),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id, manifest_sha256, expected_revision)
			REFERENCES job_content_manifests(job_id, sha256, inventory_revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id, manifest_sha256, hold_receipt_id)
			REFERENCES job_content_hold_attestations(job_id, manifest_sha256, receipt_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: idx_job_content_releases_state

schema.name: job_content_release_items
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE job_content_release_items (
		command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 1073741824),
		expected_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expected_generation > 0),
		expected_incarnation TEXT NOT NULL,
		witness_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(witness_sha256) = 64 AND witness_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		disposition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(disposition IN ('pending', 'shared_retained', 'new_generation_retained', 'deleting', 'deleted', 'absent_confirmed', 'blocked')),
		deletion_id TEXT,
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		error_code TEXT,
		PRIMARY KEY(command_id, item_id),
		UNIQUE(job_id, item_id, command_id),
		UNIQUE(command_id, item_id, store_id, sha256, size, expected_generation, expected_incarnation, witness_sha256),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id, command_id) REFERENCES job_content_releases(job_id, command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id, item_id, store_id, sha256, size, expected_generation)
			REFERENCES job_content_manifest_items(job_id, item_id, store_id, sha256, size, generation) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(store_id, sha256, size, expected_generation, expected_incarnation, witness_sha256)
			REFERENCES content_generations(store_id, sha256, size, generation, physical_incarnation_id, witness_sha256) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(deletion_id, store_id, sha256, size, expected_incarnation, witness_sha256)
			REFERENCES content_deletion_intents(deletion_id, store_id, sha256, size, expected_incarnation, witness_sha256) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: idx_job_content_release_items_disposition

schema.name: content_deletion_intents
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE content_deletion_intents (
		deletion_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		release_command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		grant_item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 1073741824),
		expected_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expected_generation > 0),
		expected_incarnation TEXT NOT NULL,
		witness_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(witness_sha256) = 64 AND witness_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		pre_change_token TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(pre_change_token) = 64 AND pre_change_token NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		post_rename_change_token TEXT CHECK(post_rename_change_token IS NULL OR (length(post_rename_change_token) = 64 AND post_rename_change_token NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
		step TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(step IN ('prepared', 'isolated', 'removed', 'blocked')),
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		UNIQUE(store_id, sha256, expected_incarnation),
		UNIQUE(deletion_id, store_id, sha256, size, expected_incarnation, witness_sha256),
		FOREIGN KEY(release_command_id, grant_item_id, store_id, sha256, size, expected_generation, expected_incarnation, witness_sha256)
			REFERENCES job_content_release_items(command_id, item_id, store_id, sha256, size, expected_generation, expected_incarnation, witness_sha256) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: idx_content_deletion_intents_step

schema.name: remote_job_content_manifests
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE remote_job_content_manifests (
		job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		reference_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reference_sequence > 0),
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 4194304),
		reference_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(reference_json) AND length(CAST(reference_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192),
		document_json TEXT CHECK(document_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(document_json) AND length(CAST(document_json AS BLOB)) = size)),
		imported INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(imported IN (0, 1)),
		CHECK((imported = 0 AND document_json IS NULL) OR (imported = 1 AND document_json IS NOT NULL)),
		UNIQUE(job_id, sha256),
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES remote_job_mirrors(job_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(job_id, reference_sequence) REFERENCES remote_job_events(job_id, sequence) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: idx_remote_job_content_manifests_imported

schema.name: client_job_content_receipts
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE client_job_content_receipts (
		receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		location_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(location_kind IN ('local', 'remote')),
		configuration_id TEXT,
		node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		installation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		spec_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(spec_sha256) = 64 AND spec_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(manifest_sha256) = 64 AND manifest_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		holder_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		actual_execution_job_id TEXT,
		remote_job_id TEXT,
		request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(request_sha256) = 64 AND request_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		document_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(document_json) AND length(CAST(document_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192),
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(delivery_state IN ('pending', 'acknowledged')),
		ack_json TEXT CHECK(ack_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(ack_json) AND length(CAST(ack_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192)),
		CHECK((location_kind = 'local' AND configuration_id IS NULL AND actual_execution_job_id IS NOT NULL AND actual_execution_job_id = job_id AND remote_job_id IS NULL)
			OR (location_kind = 'remote' AND configuration_id IS NOT NULL AND actual_execution_job_id IS NULL AND remote_job_id IS NOT NULL AND remote_job_id = job_id)),
		CHECK((delivery_state = 'pending' AND ack_json IS NULL) OR (delivery_state = 'acknowledged' AND ack_json IS NOT NULL)),
		FOREIGN KEY(actual_execution_job_id) REFERENCES execution_jobs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(remote_job_id) REFERENCES remote_job_mirrors(job_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(actual_execution_job_id, manifest_sha256) REFERENCES job_content_manifests(job_id, sha256) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(remote_job_id, manifest_sha256) REFERENCES remote_job_content_manifests(job_id, sha256) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

schema.name: client_job_content_receipt_items
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE client_job_content_receipt_items (
		receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		cache_store_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
		size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size BETWEEN 1 AND 1073741824),
		cache_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cache_generation > 0),
		witness_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(witness_sha256) = 64 AND witness_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		PRIMARY KEY(receipt_id, item_id),
		FOREIGN KEY(receipt_id) REFERENCES client_job_content_receipts(receipt_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
		FOREIGN KEY(cache_store_id, sha256, size, cache_generation, witness_sha256)
			REFERENCES content_generations(store_id, sha256, size, generation, witness_sha256) ON DELETE RESTRICT
	)

CREATE TABLE client_job_content_release_outbox (
		command_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		target_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(target_json) AND length(CAST(target_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192),
		request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(request_sha256) = 64 AND request_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
		request_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(request_json) AND length(CAST(request_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),
		revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
		delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(delivery_state IN ('pending', 'acknowledged', 'blocked')),
		ack_json TEXT CHECK(ack_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(ack_json) AND length(CAST(ack_json AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096)),
		CHECK((delivery_state = 'acknowledged' AND ack_json IS NOT NULL) OR (delivery_state != 'acknowledged' AND ack_json IS NULL)),

	)
